verdict.rationale: Windmill documents first-party AI Agent steps that run directly inside flows and connect to various AI providers and models, which covers adding LLM steps with model choice. The evidence never shows the agent step calling tools, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: documented tool-use/function-calling within AI agent steps, detail on model selection configuration, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can add AI agent or LLM steps inside a workflow, with model choice and tool use

citations.quote: AI Agents steps allow you to integrate AI agents directly into your Windmill flows. They provide an interface to connect with various AI providers and models
